newsitem.title: LATVIA: UNIBANKA AUCTION PRICE BEATS EXPECTATIONS.
newsitem.headline: UNIBANKA AUCTION PRICE BEATS EXPECTATIONS.

text.p: The auction price for the one million shares in Unibanka was higher than most people expected and the share package was shared between a couple of big investors, dealers said on Monday.
The shares were sold at 3.22 lats and dealers said they expected the price to return to the level of 3.30 lats, where it was at before the auction was announced.
Immediately after the auction was announced, Unibanka's shares slid as low as 3.10 lats.
"Most of the market had expected a lower (auction) price of 3.10 to 3.15 lats per share," Edgars Stalbovs, a dealer with Baltic Transit Bank, told Reuters.
Others saw interest for bigger packages of Unibanka behind the higher price.
"If one wants bigger chunks (of the shares) one has to pay above the bourse price, which today was 3.21 lats," said Roberts Idelsons, head of the Trasta Bank Securities department.
"Unibanka's results are good enough to generate interest from big investors and today's auction had a couple of them taking part," he added.
The auction results are not going to influence Unibanka bourse showing significantly.
"Once unclearness connected to the auction is gone Unibanka could return tol its pre-auction pricve level of 3.30 lats to 3.40 lats," Idelsons said.
